annotations.title: HTTP Security Headers Check (A+ to F grade)

description: Grades a URL's HTTP security headers A+ to F (0-100) from one live fetch after up to 5 validated redirects. Per header: present, value, rating, points, issue, fix for HSTS, Content-Security-Policy (unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, wildcards, frame-ancestors), X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, COEP, CORP; Server/X-Powered-By version leaks; cookie Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite flags; missing list, summary. DNS via Cloudflare DoH. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

url.description: http or https URL, or a bare domain (checked as https://). Default ports only; credentials, IP addresses, localhost and private or single-label names are rejected.
